core.access.all-files.denied: Full Disk Access is off for Fresher. Click Open System Settings, turn on Fresher in the list, then come back and scan again.
core.access.all-files.how: 1. Click Open System Settings. 2. Turn on Fresher in the list. 3. Come back to Fresher and scan again.
core.access.all-files.missing: Some folders could not be read because Fresher does not have Full Disk Access.
core.access.all-files.name: Full Disk Access
core.access.all-files.unlocks: Lets Fresher see every folder on this Mac, including the ones macOS protects, such as Mail and Safari data. Fresher still reads only names and sizes.
core.access.desktop.denied: macOS did not let Fresher look in Desktop. Click Open System Settings, turn on Fresher under Files and Folders, then scan again.
core.access.desktop.description: macOS will ask you once. Fresher reads names and sizes only, and removes nothing unless you confirm it.
core.access.desktop.how: 1. Click Let Fresher look there. 2. Scan again. 3. When macOS asks, click Allow.
core.access.desktop.label: Let Fresher look in Desktop
core.access.desktop.missing: Your Desktop was not looked at.
core.access.desktop.name: Desktop folder
core.access.desktop.unlocks: Lets Fresher measure what takes space on your Desktop.
core.access.documents.denied: macOS did not let Fresher look in Documents. Click Open System Settings, turn on Fresher under Files and Folders, then scan again.
core.access.documents.description: macOS will ask you once. Fresher reads names and sizes only, and removes nothing unless you confirm it.
core.access.documents.how: 1. Click Let Fresher look there. 2. Scan again. 3. When macOS asks, click Allow.
core.access.documents.label: Let Fresher look in Documents
core.access.documents.missing: Your Documents folder was not looked at.
core.access.documents.name: Documents folder
core.access.documents.unlocks: Lets Fresher measure what takes space in Documents, such as old project folders.
core.access.downloads.denied: macOS did not let Fresher look in Downloads. Click Open System Settings, turn on Fresher under Files and Folders, then scan again.
core.access.downloads.description: macOS will ask you once. Fresher reads names and sizes only, and removes nothing unless you confirm it.
core.access.downloads.how: 1. Click Let Fresher look there. 2. Scan again. 3. When macOS asks, click Allow.
core.access.downloads.label: Let Fresher look in Downloads
core.access.downloads.missing: Your Downloads folder was not looked at.
core.access.downloads.name: Downloads folder
core.access.downloads.unlocks: Lets Fresher measure what takes space in Downloads, such as old installers.
core.access.network-volume.denied: macOS did not let Fresher look in the network folder. Click Open System Settings, turn on Network Volumes for Fresher under Files and Folders, then scan again.
core.access.network-volume.how: 1. Add the network folder to the folders to scan. 2. Scan again. 3. When macOS asks, click Allow.
core.access.network-volume.missing: The network folder was not looked at.
core.access.network-volume.name: Network folders
core.access.network-volume.unlocks: Lets Fresher measure what takes space in a network folder you added to the folders it scans.
core.access.other-apps-data.denied: macOS did not let Fresher look at other apps' data. Click Open System Settings, allow Fresher under Privacy & Security, then scan again.
core.access.other-apps-data.description: macOS will ask you once. Fresher reads names and sizes only, and removes nothing unless you confirm it.
core.access.other-apps-data.how: 1. Click Let Fresher look there. 2. Scan again. 3. When macOS asks, click Allow.
core.access.other-apps-data.label: Let Fresher look at other apps' data
core.access.other-apps-data.missing: The data other apps keep for themselves was not looked at.
core.access.other-apps-data.name: Other apps' data
core.access.other-apps-data.unlocks: Lets Fresher measure the data other apps keep for themselves, such as their caches.
core.access.removable-volume.denied: macOS did not let Fresher look on the external drive. Click Open System Settings, turn on Removable Volumes for Fresher under Files and Folders, then scan again.
core.access.removable-volume.how: 1. Add the drive to the folders to scan. 2. Scan again. 3. When macOS asks, click Allow.
core.access.removable-volume.missing: The external drive was not looked at.
core.access.removable-volume.name: External drives
core.access.removable-volume.unlocks: Lets Fresher measure what takes space on a drive you added to the folders it scans.
core.access.tool.not-installed: {tool} is not installed. Install it, then scan again.
core.access.tool.not-ready: {tool} is installed but not running. Start it, then scan again.
core.build.trash.sandbox: Cleanups move items to the sandbox's Trash: {path}
core.build.trash.system: Cleanups move the sandbox's items to the Trash of this Mac.
core.cleanup.blocked.disk-full: The disk is too full to record the cleanup. Empty the Trash or free a little space, then try again.
core.cleanup.blocked.journal: The cleanup history cannot be written, and Fresher removes nothing without a record. Restart or update the app, then try again.
core.cleanup.blocked.open-files: Fresher could not check which files apps are using, so it removed nothing. Try again in a moment.
core.cleanup.blocked.settings: Your settings could not be read, so Fresher cannot know what you asked it to ignore. Restart the app, then try again.
core.cleanup.ended.cancelled: Stopped by you. The items after that point were not touched.
core.cleanup.ended.interrupted: Interrupted: Fresher quit during this cleanup.
core.cleanup.ended.stopped: Stopped because the cleanup history could not be saved. The items after that point were not touched.
core.cleanup.failed.landed-elsewhere: Another item was moved to the Trash in its place. You can put it back.
core.cleanup.failed.partly: Only {done} of its {of} files went; the rest stayed in place. What went is in the Trash.
core.cleanup.failed.partly-deleted: Only {done} of its {of} files went; the rest stayed in place. The files that went were deleted and cannot be put back.
core.cleanup.failed.tool-failed: The tool that made this item could not remove it, so it is still there. Close the app that uses it, then try again.
core.cleanup.failed.tool-missing: The tool could not be started. Check that it is installed and running.
core.cleanup.failed.trash-refused: macOS refused to move it to the Trash.
core.cleanup.outcome.not-reached: Not removed: the cleanup stopped before this item.
core.cleanup.outcome.unknown: Unknown: Fresher stopped during this cleanup. Check the Trash.
core.cleanup.put-back.failed: macOS refused to move it back, so it stayed in the Trash.
core.cleanup.put-back.gone: It is no longer in the Trash, so it cannot be put back.
core.cleanup.put-back.no-parent: The folder it was in is gone, so it stayed in the Trash.
core.cleanup.put-back.not-trashed: It was not moved to the Trash, so it cannot be put back.
core.cleanup.put-back.occupied: Something is already at its old place, so it stayed in the Trash. Show it in the Trash to decide.
core.cleanup.put-back.refused: Its old place cannot be used now, so it stayed in the Trash.
core.cleanup.put-back.replaced: Something else is in its place in the Trash, so nothing was put back.
core.cleanup.skip.check-failed: Fresher could not check it, so it left it alone.
core.cleanup.skip.covered: It is inside another item of this cleanup, so it goes with that one.
core.cleanup.skip.forced-tool: The tool would have been told to force the removal, so Fresher left it alone.
core.cleanup.skip.dry-run: Development build: a dry run. It passed every check and was left where it is.
core.cleanup.skip.grown: It grew a lot since you reviewed it, so Fresher left it alone.
core.cleanup.skip.grown.how: Scan again and review it once more.
core.cleanup.skip.ignored: It is on your list of items to ignore.
core.cleanup.skip.in-use: An app is using it, so Fresher left it alone.
core.cleanup.skip.kind-changed: It changed from a file to a folder, or the other way round, so Fresher left it alone.
core.cleanup.skip.kind-changed.how: Scan again to see what is there now.
core.cleanup.skip.missing-capability: Fresher is not allowed to remove it.
core.cleanup.skip.missing-capability.how: Open Settings, then Permissions, to see how to allow it.
core.cleanup.skip.no-trash: This disk has no Trash, so the item stayed where it is.
core.cleanup.skip.no-trash.how: To remove it, start a new cleanup and choose Delete permanently.
core.cleanup.skip.not-in-sandbox: Development build: removal works only in a sandbox folder.
core.cleanup.skip.not-the-subject: The rule that found it asked to remove a different place, so Fresher left it alone.
core.cleanup.skip.other-volume: It is on another disk than the folder that was scanned, so Fresher left it alone.
core.cleanup.skip.outside-roots: It is outside the folders Fresher scans, so it was left alone.
core.cleanup.skip.protected: Fresher never removes this place, because macOS or your data depends on it.
core.cleanup.skip.replaced: Something else is in its place now, so Fresher left it alone.
core.cleanup.skip.replaced.how: Scan again to see what is there now.
core.cleanup.skip.through-link: Its path goes through a link, so Fresher left it alone.
core.cleanup.skip.whole-folder: This is one of your main folders. Fresher removes items inside it, never the whole folder.
core.cleanup.trash.replaced: Something else is in its place in the Trash.
core.completeness.partial: Some files could not be read, so the real size is a little bigger.
core.completeness.unknown: The size could not be measured.
core.danger.high.meaning: May hold the only copy of your data. Removing it can lose work.
core.danger.high.name: High
core.danger.low.meaning: Comes back when needed, but that takes time or a download.
core.danger.low.name: Low
core.danger.medium.meaning: Can be restored, but not by itself. You may need to set something up again.
core.danger.medium.name: Medium
core.danger.safe.meaning: Comes back by itself when needed. Removing it costs only a little time.
core.danger.safe.name: Safe
core.error.busy: The app is already running a {running}. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it.
core.error.cannot-ignore: This item belongs to another app, so it cannot be ignored yet. Ignore its whole section instead.
core.error.cleaning-blocked: Fresher cannot remove anything right now, so nothing was removed.
core.error.internal: Something went wrong inside the app, and it stopped safely. Try again, or restart the app.
core.error.invalid-setting-value: This value does not fit the setting {key}. Check it and try again.
core.error.missing-capability: Fresher is not allowed to do this yet. Open Settings, then Permissions, to see how to allow it.
core.error.no-settings-pane: There is no system setting to change for this.
core.error.not-in-trash: This item is no longer in the Trash.
core.error.not-own-item: This item cannot be chosen here.
core.error.not-running: Nothing is running, so there is nothing to cancel.
core.error.nothing-to-clean: Nothing is selected. Pick the items to remove first.
core.error.nothing-to-reveal: This item is not a file or folder, so it cannot be shown in Finder.
core.error.plan-gone: This list is out of date: it is older than 10 minutes, or the scan results changed since. Review it again.
core.error.plan-mismatch: What you confirmed is not the list Fresher prepared, so nothing was removed. Review the list again.
core.error.settings-read-only: Your settings cannot be changed now: they were saved by a newer version of the app, or the settings file could not be read. Restart or update the app, then try again.
core.error.stale-node: This view is out of date: the scan results changed. Open it again.
core.error.storage: Your settings could not be saved. Check that the disk has free space, then try again.
core.error.too-many-items: That is more than {limit} items, too many to review at once. Pick fewer, then try again.
core.error.unknown-category: There is no kind of item called {id}. Scan again, then pick what to remove.
core.error.unknown-cleanup: There is no cleanup number {id} in the history.
core.error.unknown-cleanup-item: This item is not part of that cleanup.
core.error.unknown-finding: Item {id} is no longer in the list. Scan again to see what is there now.
core.error.unknown-group: No part of the app belongs to the group {id}. Restart the app and try again.
core.error.unknown-locale: There are no texts for the language {locale}.
core.error.unknown-module: There is no part of the app called {id}. Restart the app and try again.
core.error.unknown-setting: There is no setting called {key}. Restart the app and try again.
core.error.unknown-trash: This Trash is no longer listed. Look again on the scan screen.
core.error.unknown-volume: This disk is no longer listed. Open Scan again.
core.group.apps.description: What apps leave behind, such as the files of apps you removed.
core.group.apps.name: Apps
core.group.debug.description: Modules of a development build, for trying the app. They never ship.
core.group.debug.name: Debug
core.group.development.description: Tools for building software: IDEs, package managers, containers and project folders.
core.group.development.name: Development
core.group.files.description: Files you downloaded or keep yourself, such as old installers and big downloads.
core.group.files.name: Your files
core.group.system.description: What macOS and your apps keep for themselves, such as temporary files.
core.group.system.name: System
core.ignore.categories.description: Fresher leaves these kinds of items out of the results and never removes them. Restore one to see it again.
core.ignore.categories.label: Ignored kinds of items
core.ignore.groups.description: Hides everything the modules of this group find and never cleans it. Your files stay as they are; you can restore it at any time.
core.ignore.groups.label: Ignored groups
core.ignore.modules.description: Hides everything this module finds and never cleans it. Your files stay as they are; you can restore it at any time.
core.ignore.modules.label: Ignored modules
core.ignore.paths.description: Fresher leaves these items, and everything inside them, out of the results and never removes them or a folder that holds them.
core.ignore.paths.label: Ignored items
core.largest.min-size.description: Files and folders smaller than this are not listed on the Largest screen. Nothing is removed by this setting.
core.largest.min-size.label: Smallest size on Largest
core.largest.unchanged.half-year: Not changed for half a year
core.largest.unpacked: A folder named {folder} beside it may hold what was unpacked from it.
core.largest.withheld.app: An app. It is not removed from here.
core.largest.withheld.explained: Fresher explains this on Scan; choose it there.
core.largest.withheld.hidden: Kept by an app or a tool for itself. Fresher cannot tell what it holds.
core.largest.withheld.holds-explained: Part of it is explained on Scan. Open it to choose the rest.
core.largest.withheld.ignored: You chose to ignore this place.
core.largest.withheld.library: Your apps keep their own files here. Scan shows what of it can go.
core.largest.withheld.link: A link to another place. Only the link would go.
core.largest.withheld.protected: macOS or Fresher protects this place.
core.largest.withheld.read-in-part: Fresher could not read all of it, so it cannot tell what it holds.
core.largest.withheld.standard-folder: A standard folder of your Mac. Open it to choose what is inside.
core.largest.withheld.trash: What is already in the Trash. Empty it from the Finder.
core.module.panicked: This part of the app stopped because of an error inside it. The other parts finished their scan.
core.module.unavailable: This part of the app could not run, because it is missing what it needs.
core.motion.description: How much the app animates. Follow your Mac uses the Reduce motion setting of macOS; Reduced keeps only gentle fades.
core.motion.label: Motion
core.own-file.comes-back: No. Put them back from the Trash or from Cleanups if you need them.
core.own-file.if-removed: They go to the Trash. Fresher cannot tell what they hold or whether you still need them.
core.own-file.made-by: You, or the apps you use.
core.own-file.name: Your own files
core.own-file.reason.file: This is your own file; Fresher cannot tell whether you still need it.
core.own-file.reason.folder: This is your own folder; Fresher cannot tell whether you still need what is in it.
core.own-file.title: {name}
core.own-file.what: Files and folders you picked yourself on the Largest screen.
core.place.shared-temp.name: Shared temporary folder
core.place.user-temp.name: Your temporary folder
core.removability.locked.how: This item is locked. Unlock it in Finder's Get Info window if you want to remove it.
core.removability.locked.name: Locked
core.removability.needs-administrator.ho: Only an administrator can remove this. Show it in Finder and drag it to the Trash; macOS will ask for an administrator password.
core.removability.protected-by-system.ho: macOS protects this item to keep the system working. Fresher shows it only so you know what takes the space.
core.removability.removable.name: Can be removed
core.scan.outcome.partial: The scan stopped early or could not read some folders. What it found so far is shown.
core.scan.roots.description: The scan looks only inside these folders. Your home folder is the default.
core.scan.roots.label: Folders to scan
core.start.failed: Fresher could not start. It changed nothing on your Mac. Quit it and open it again; if this happens again, reinstall Fresher.
core.storage.changed: The disk changed during the scan, so some numbers are a little off. Scan again for exact numbers.
core.storage.not-scanned.avoided: Not opened: macOS guards it, and Fresher looks there only with your permission.
core.storage.not-scanned.other-volume: On another disk, so it was not scanned with this folder.
core.storage.not-scanned.others-folder: Belongs to another user of this Mac, so Fresher did not open it.
core.storage.not-scanned.system-items: macOS keeps its own items here private, so Fresher never opens them.
core.storage.not-scanned.unreadable.guar: Protected by macOS. Full Disk Access lets the next scan measure it.
core.storage.not-scanned.unreadable.no-p: Its permissions do not let Fresher read it.
core.storage.part.disk-own.description: Space the disk keeps for itself, such as the recovery system and the file system's records. It cannot be cleaned.
core.storage.part.disk-own.name: The disk's own space
core.storage.part.explained.description: What Fresher recognised, such as caches, logs and old build files. Each item says how safe it is to remove.
core.storage.part.explained.name: Explained
core.storage.part.free.description: Space you can still use for new files.
core.storage.part.free.name: Free
core.storage.part.mac-os.description: The system itself and the files it needs to start and update. macOS looks after this space; it cannot be cleaned.
core.storage.part.mac-os.name: macOS
core.storage.part.not-scanned-yet.descri: Space the scan has not reached yet. It shrinks as the scan goes on.
core.storage.part.not-scanned-yet.name: Not scanned yet
core.storage.part.other-volume.descripti: Another volume of yours on the same disk. Add it in Settings → Scan to see inside.
core.storage.part.other-volume.name: Another volume
core.storage.part.swap-and-sleep.descrip: Memory macOS keeps on the disk when it runs low or the Mac sleeps. macOS looks after it; restarting the Mac can make it smaller.
core.storage.part.swap-and-sleep.name: Swap and sleep image
core.storage.part.your-folders.descripti: Files Fresher looked at but does not recognise. Fresher never suggests removing them.
core.storage.part.your-folders.name: Your folders
core.storage.place.trash.description: You get this space back when you empty the Trash.
core.storage.place.trash.name: Trash
core.storage.purgeable: macOS can free about {size} more on its own when space runs low
core.storage.reason.changed-during-scan: Files changed on the disk while the scan ran.
core.storage.reason.snapshots-and-bookke: Local snapshots and the file system's own records, which macOS looks after.
core.storage.reason.unreadable: Folders Fresher could not read. Allowing access lets the next scan measure them.
core.storage.remainder.not-measured.desc: Used space the scan could not measure. The reasons are listed below.
core.storage.remainder.not-measured.name: Not measured
core.storage.remainder.outside.descripti: Apps, the system's data and other users' files, which the scan did not look at. Add the disk in Settings → Scan to see inside.
core.storage.remainder.outside.name: Outside the scanned folders
